# Houzz

> > Houzz is a leading home remodeling and design platform featuring millions of interior design photos, professional portfolios, and inspiration for every room and style.

Houzz connects homeowners with design professionals and provides comprehensive photo galleries organized by room type, style, and specific design elements. The platform includes Houzz Pro tools for professionals and Houzz Research insights for the industry.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Home Remodeling
- Design Inspiration
- Photo Galleries
- Kitchen Design
- Bathroom Design
- Bedroom Design
- Living Room Design
- Design Portfolios
- Home Decor
- Design Styles
- Room Layouts
- Houzz Pro
- Professional Services
- Design Trends

## Core Design Galleries

- [75 Home Design Ideas You'll Love - March, 2026 | Houzz](https://www.houzz.com/photos/home-design-ideas-phbr0-bp~): Main photo gallery showcasing home design ideas across all rooms
- [75 Kitchen Ideas You'll Love - March, 2026 | Houzz](https://www.houzz.com/photos/kitchen-ideas-and-designs-phbr0-bp~t_709): Kitchen remodel gallery with countertop, storage, and layout ideas
- [75 Bathroom Ideas You'll Love - March, 2026 | Houzz](https://www.houzz.com/photos/bathroom-ideas-phbr0-bp~t_712): Bathroom design inspiration with layouts, storage, and style options
- [75 Living Room Ideas You'll Love - March, 2026 | Houzz](https://www.houzz.com/photos/living-room-ideas-phbr0-bp~t_718): Living room design gallery featuring furniture layouts and decor ideas
- [75 Bedroom Ideas You'll Love - March, 2026 | Houzz](https://www.houzz.com/photos/bedroom-ideas-and-designs-phbr0-bp~t_715): Bedroom design ideas gallery with layouts, colors, and decor inspiration

## Specialized Design Ideas

- [Painted Kitchen Cabinets - Photos & Ideas | Houzz](https://www.houzz.com/photos/query/painted-kitchen-cabinets): Painted kitchen cabinet photo gallery with style and color inspiration
